title: very short sword
description: A resource pack for those who want something too short
body:
A resource pack for those who want something too short
Made using MCreator
But was there any point in using MCreator for something like this?

日本語:
短さを求めすぎた人のためのリソースパック
MCreatorを使って作りました
でもこんなものにMCreatorを使う意味あったかな
